limitations: No independent pedestal/bumper/shoulder survey or physical print tolerance
Existing one-plane front intrinsics extrapolated to elevated marker; no new independent multi-tilt lens calibration
F/G/F brackets acquired only at visible reference poses, not every joint-sweep pose
No full global two-joint joint-bundle/planner/real-TF adoption package; pure-joint corner-space fits only
Later centred D reconstructions are independent checks against A/B; D reconstruction values are not claimed third-session frozen-model predictions
Pose labels nominal; latent measured rotations used for axis fits; refused/partial jogs retained
No independent proof of 5mm/1deg absolute placement; sensitivity scenarios are assumptions, not surveyed bounds
